BetterScratch verification

A badge for your Scratch profile.

Find out how to qualify automatically, or apply for community verification.

Automatic verification

More than 1,000 followers.

Your Scratch account qualifies automatically when it has 1,001 or more followers. Scratch Team accounts also qualify automatically.

Turn on Show BetterScratch verification and Look up public account data in BetterScratch to let the extension check your public Scratch profile and show your badge.

No application is needed for automatic verification.

Community verification

Below the follower requirement?

You can apply for verification if your Scratch account is at least one year old, even if you do not have more than 1,000 followers.

The one-year requirement applies to applications. Applying does not automatically grant verification.

Apply for verification ↗

What the badge means

This is a BetterScratch extension badge. It appears for people using BetterScratch with verification badges enabled and is not official Scratch verification.
